Container.Name: Sablier
Container.Overview: Sablier is a lightweight open-source application that automatically starts Docker containers on demand and stops them after a period of inactivity. It integrates with reverse proxies such as Traefik, Caddy and Nginx to provide scale-to-zero capabilities for Docker workloads.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: sablier scale to zero docker traefik caddy nginx reverse proxy container sleep wake
Container.Requires: Docker access and a reverse proxy integration such as Traefik, Caddy or Nginx.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: Port used by the Sablier HTTP API.

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: Docker socket used by Sablier to start, stop and monitor Docker containers.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone used by the Sablier container.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: Sablier logging level. Supported values include info, debug and error.
